_comment: Competitor channels we study via transcripts (never by 'watching'). Blueprint extractor + daily loop consume video IDs from learning_queue.txt; daily agent sessions use yt-dlp search to find outlier candidates and enqueue them.

channels.name: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
channels.why: The ceiling for science-What-If production value. Study pacing, hook density, how abstract concepts get made visual.

channels.name: AlternateHistoryHub
channels.why: The What-If storytelling benchmark: divergence-point structure, domino chains, 3-act escalation.

channels.name: MinutePhysics
channels.why: Hand-drawn minimalism = our stickman aesthetic ancestor. Study how simple visuals carry dense ideas.

channels.name: MinuteEarth
channels.why: Fast, dense, captioned minimal animation. Great WPM and cut-density reference for Shorts.

outlier_rule.formula: Outlier Score = video views / channel average views
outlier_rule.action: Flag any candidate with score >= 5x; enqueue its transcript for blueprint extraction the same day.
